summary: Telix reports an active resubmission review, but no diagnostic-accuracy results are supplied. Safety and manufacturing are also unassessed, leaving insufficient evidence for a directional assessment of this glioma-imaging application.
pivotalQuestion: Does the resubmitted package establish adequate diagnostic accuracy for distinguishing recurrent or progressive glioma from treatment-related change?

factors.rationale: The intended use is distinguishing glioma recurrence or progression from treatment-related change; no diagnostic-accuracy analyses are supplied for this application.
The packet provides no candidate-specific safety results; absence of disclosed concerns does not establish a favorable safety profile.
No product-linked manufacturing, facility-compliance, or CMC findings are supplied. Resubmission acceptance does not establish manufacturing clearance.
Telix reported FDA acceptance of the March resubmission and reaffirmed the September 11 target in August. These support review progress, not efficacy or approval.
